description: The base URL of the AGENT-ENV delivery endpoint (D-341), a template: {id} is the environment's id and $NAME a variable of the session (the port's URL, TOWER_PORT_URL), so no host of the account is written in the repository. The client GETs <endpoint>/v1/agent-env and POSTs <endpoint>/v1/torre with the environment's starting credential. Empty, or naming a variable the session does not have, is not provisioned: the client prints one line and fetches nothing, and preflight names it as a warning, never a gap.
